Title: Through the Gates of Great Cleave
Description: Recover supplies being shipped through the blockade and rescue the Wardens who accompanied the delivery.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="grace_gestureLeftM" />There is an old outpost in the foothills to the Northeast, and Yonas<g id="female_youknowS" /> resolved that he and a handful of Wardens would push through enemy lines and capture it.
InProgressResponse: We must<g id="male_clenchFistRight" /> recover those supplies for the outpost.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="male_nodMild" />When I saw Galahad coming up the road with those supplies, I<g id="yonas_cheerBothhands" /> couldn't believe it! And now the rescue of our captured Wardens as well.

Title: Secrets in the Ruins
Description: Visit the Ancient Ruins to find out what the Corrupted have been after.
PlayerPrompt: "Whatever it is, it can't be good."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="yonas_lefthand" />My thoughts exactly,<g id="yonas_headshakeDisappointed" /> and that is why I deemed the capture of this outpost to be of critical importance.
InProgressResponse: If this Commander gets his<g id="yonas_headshakeDisappointed" /> hands on some Ancient source of power, all could be lost.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Your arrival is well-timed.<g id="male_sighRelief" /> Our scouts have just returned with excellent news<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> - the forces of the Corrupted are vulnerable as they've spread out.

Title: Assessing the Enemy
Description: Join Yonas at one of the forts, get past its defenses, and discover how the Corrupted plan on contacting the source of Corruption.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, and the sooner<g id="female_leftfistThreaten" /> we can dismantle their efforts, the better.
InProgressResponse: Ironically, though we have far fewer soldiers than we had during the Wars of Crimson Madness, I<g id="male_nodProud" /> believe we may yet have a chance of victory in all this.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You<g id="yonas_laughXl" /> charged into the fort and against a small army, and now you return unscathed. That alone is quite a feat.

Title: Sabotage the Supply Chain
Description: Assault the mines to cripple Thorpe's mining operation.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Bah!<g id="yonas_throwarmsFrustrated" /> You're as bull-headed now as the day I met you, but my strength is renewed and I will not stand idly by.
InProgressResponse: I suspect these portals<g id="yonas_leftfist" /> they're building may be on the high peaks to the west. We will see.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="yonas_lefthand" />I heard the fire of cannons and<g id="yonas_suppressLaugh" /> hoped that had been something you did, rather than something aimed at you.

Title: All Part of the Plan
Description: Fight your way across the bridge, meet with Yash, and disable the forts on your way to the western outpost.
PlayerPrompt: "We need to get across the bridge."
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes,<g id="yonas_nod" /> I am prepared to make the assault whenever you are,<g id="yonas_realize" /> but speak to Galahad first and at least<g id="yonas_shrug" /> hear out the bright knight's plan.
InProgressResponse: If we are to have any hope of stopping the Corrupted, we need to take<g id="yonas_gestureDown" /> back control of the bridge.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This outpost is beyond<g id="male_goodnews" /> the scope of what we planned,<g id="female_gesturebothhands" /> but I believe it will yield great value in our longer campaign against the Corrupted.

Title: Mounting An Attack
Description: Follow the route of the ore through the mountain road and destroy any Unfinished Portals.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: He's gone off with Yonas, and<g id="female_leanpointConvince" /> you should follow with haste. The ore trail leads up into the Ancient ruins on the western peaks.
InProgressResponse: <g id="male_nodMild" />I'll remain here and ensure this location is secure and you<g id="male_salute2Fingers" /> and your Wardens are not attacked from behind.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="yonas_throwarmsFrustrated" />Blast it all! I am<g id="yonas_handsExtendedSorry" /> sorry, young one. I hoped to share some of the burden that has been so unevenly put on you.

Title: Beyond the Gates
Description: Rescue the captured Soulwardens, push on to the top of the mountain, confront Thorpe, and close the portal to Corruption.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes,<g id="yonas_noddingSubtle" /> but Warden Yash places too much faith<g id="yonas_shiftWeight" /> in me, I fear. He escaped as well<g id="yonas_righthand02" /> and ranges ahead to assess the enemy position.
InProgressResponse: Together we are stronger<g id="yonas_gestureForward" /> than anything Corruption sends our way.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Heh, I can't<g id="yonas_lookrightPensive" /> believe I doubted you for even a second… but that portal, I shudder to think of what you may have witnessed in there.

Title: To Stand Against The Dark
Description: Talk to Yonas about the plan of battle, then track down and fight Commander Thorpe.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: I will<g id="yonas_pointForwardThreaten" /> NOT tolerate your bull-headed arguments this time!<g id="yonas_explain01" /> I'm ordering you to go south and attack Thorpe's camp before reinforcements arrive.
InProgressResponse: If our Order is to survive this war, we must defeat Commander Thorpe. We'll<g id="yonas_fisthigh" /> keep the reinforcements out, but the hard fight is on you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="female_smackfist" />You defeated the bastard,<g id="female_headshakeSmall" /> didn't you? Then it was worth it.

Title: Wounds Run Deep
Description: Return to the outpost and find supplies to heal Yonas. Meet up with Grace and get word from Caer Dun.
PlayerPrompt: "Is he alright? Can he be healed?"
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Well, he's<g id="female_sighRelief" /> in no danger of dying,<g id="female_gestureLeftS" /> but his mind is what I fear for.
InProgressResponse: I still cannot<g id="male_spreadarmsCalm" /> believe we made it through that. I've never seen so many Corrupted in one place.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Well now, there's no<g id="grace_proud" /> need to shower me with gratitude and gold, I'm just doing my part for the Soulwardens.

Title: A Better Defense
Description: Shore up the defenses of Caer Dun to protect against future attacks.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Well,<g id="grace_gestureAround" /> Morgaine came into the command tent, saying something about using the Angry Earth Blight in Edengrove to fight Corruption.
